Game Overview

Last of the Noobs. Zombie Attack puts players into a shooter experience centered on survive the undead chaos in "Last of the Noobs: Zombie Attack." Journey through a zombie-infested world, battling through missions to obtain crucial virus samples. Master dodge-and-attack tactics, wield unique weapons, and rise in the leaderboards as you strive for a cure. Can you outsmart the relentless horde?
